sourceInformation.genre: Sports; fitness comedy; light life sim
sourceInformation.perspective: Isometric island, front-on classes, fixed views for balance games
sourceInformation.tech: Pixel Engine 0.46.0, three.js 0.186.0, Rapier 0.20.0, esbuild 0.28.2; JavaScript ES modules
sourceInformation.artDirection: Native pixel pipeline, toon palette, original low-poly wellness island, characters and equipment
sourceInformation.animation: Engine ClipDef and AnimationMixer; original poses, reps and gestures; PlatformerCharacter
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-only Song and SoundDef music/SFX, deterministic Web Audio formant gibberish; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub Session Protocol v1, client 1.4.0; 1-4 player ghost Medley; local Family Hour
sourceInformation.testing: Headless gameplay and scripted week, browser automation, pad stubs, audio analysis, viewport and Hub harness checks; no physical controller, TV, touch device or iOS Safari
sourceInformation.research: Read the supplied plan and full engine GUIDE.md, ASSETS.md and Hub README; searched engine API and asset library. The director supplied engine/Hub research and verified spikes.

testingFeedback: 22 functional and visual issues were caught and corrected, grouping related symptoms as one issue.
Two could block a flow: a scene-transition/voice race, and starting Family Hour with only a controller.
The real-menu seven-day playthrough, followed by browser pad, viewport, audio and four Hub harness runs.
Title-only smoke checks gave little coverage of the story, multiple devices, pause or resized HUD.
engineFeedback: Data-authored models and clips, the pixel renderer and the shared headless runtime made a complete game practical.
I first analyzed clips on a posed model. A neutral rig exposed two foot-placement errors. Menu time also needed the unscaled replay delta.
The unstable Dot, shared activity rules/drivers, controller HUD and persistent week/story framework.
Coordinating asynchronous scene loads, fixed-step gameplay, paused UI time, animation feet and manual WebGPU captures.
None. The shipped pixel-engine.js is byte-identical to the downloaded 0.46.0 kit.
Expose unscaled UI frame time directly on GameContext.
promptFeedback: The clear tone, four pillars, exact mechanics and verified engine/Hub recipes gave the game a strong direction.
The brief asks for a vertical slice while the plan describes a whole week and seventeen activities.
Keeping all activities, controller/keyboard/mouse controls, story progression and online sessions consistent and readable.
Separate core acceptance criteria from optional polish, while keeping the verified recipes and testing stand-ins.

aiHub.name: Fit of Stillness
aiHub.tagline: A little balance. A lot of notes.
aiHub.description: A week on a wellness island run by a polite, deeply judgmental scale. Balance, breathe and wobble through classes with friends, then discover why everyone is seven years older than expected.
aiHub.controls: Left stick, WASD or mouse: lean. R2, Space or click: breathe. L1/R1, F/J or mouse buttons: step.
